headline_hint: Why DraftKings (DKNG) stock is down today
instructions: The move is happening now. Use the latest quote; if the session has closed by the time you write, use the close and say so. The company reported results today or last night: make the results the cause, and link the recap if one exists.

facts.name: DraftKings
sentences: DraftKings's shares moved 5% or more on 25 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 4 November 2026, when the stock rose 5.4%.
The stock is down 31.8% this year, and at $23.52 it sits 35.1% below its 52-week closing high of $36.24 from 5 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in DraftKings five years ago would be worth $539 today.
